action: Upgrade customer-managed NetScaler ADC and Gateway to 14.1-73.57 or 13.1-64.39, FIPS builds to 14.1-73.58 FIPS or 13.1-37.293. Do internet-facing Gateway and AAA appliances first.
exec: The EU institutions' own response team rates two NetScaler flaws critical, reachable without authentication; treat the upgrade as urgent.
plain: The EU institutions' cyber team says Citrix NetScaler remote-access equipment has critical flaws that outsiders could reach without logging in, including one that affects every device even with default settings.

key_findings: The advisory counts 28 memory flaws in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway; most depend on specific features.
CVE-2026-120868 (CVSS 9.3) is a memory overflow in core packet processing needing no authentication or special feature, so default configurations are affected.
CVE-2026-107412 (CVSS 9.5) covers several memory overflows on appliances configured as a Gateway or AAA virtual server, reportedly reachable without authentication.
Affected: 14.1 before 14.1-73.57, 13.1 before 13.1-64.39, ADC FIPS before 14.1-73.58 FIPS, and FIPS and NDcPP before 13.1-37.293.
Citrix reports no exploitation, and no public proof of concept has been confirmed.
recommendations: Upgrade all customer-managed NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances to the fixed releases.
Upgrade internet-facing Gateway and AAA appliances first.

summary: CERT-EU Security Advisory 2026-020 covers 28 memory flaws in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway. CVE-2026-120868, scored 9.3, sits in core packet processing and affects every deployment, default configuration included, without authentication. CVE-2026-107412, scored 9.5, affects appliances set up as a Gateway or AAA virtual server. Citrix reports no exploitation and no public proof of concept is confirmed.
title: CERT-EU rates Citrix NetScaler flaws critical: unauthenticated memory overflows scored up to 9.5

validation.note: Reviewed against the original CERT-EU document.
